audit_metadata.auditor_role: Principal ML Research Auditor & Reproducibility Specialist

forensic_investigation.origin: Analytical simulation and parameter estimation based on Phase 12B cross-encoder benchmark (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, 22.7M parameters) combined with section truncation analysis.
forensic_investigation.reason: No row-level prediction CSV exists on disk for a fine-tuned cross-encoder directly trained on dual_unseen_train_v1 and evaluated on dual_unseen_val_v1. The values in cross_encoder_vs_bi_encoder_comparison.json were analytically estimated from Phase 12B / 12D benchmark figures rather than emitted by an active serialized checkpoint.

calibration_audit.structural_limitation: The folds are strictly candidate-disjoint (zero candidate overlap across folds). However, jobs are not disjoint across folds (an average of ~30 jobs overlap between inner training and outer validation). This is expected because the validation set contains 52 unique jobs across 91 candidates. Outer validation labels were strictly excluded during threshold selection, preventing direct label leakage.

statistical_audit.pooled_mcnemar_classification: EXPLORATORY DESCRIPTIVE EVIDENCE ONLY (Repeats 296 pairs across 5 seeds; not 1,480 independent samples)

latency_memory_audit.hardware_environment: Intel/AMD x86_64, Windows OS, Single-Threaded CPU Execution

production_end_to_end_pipeline.pipeline_scope: Raw text cleaning -> Structural parsing -> Skill extraction -> Feature transform (2,518 dims) -> LogReg inference

cross_encoder_minilm_l6_v2.pipeline_scope: Raw text tokenization (max 512 tokens) -> 6-layer Transformer Cross-Encoder forward pass -> Logit classification

latency_memory_audit.methodological_finding: Previously reported 0.004 ms for production was a CLASSIFIER-ONLY forward pass on pre-computed feature vectors. Full end-to-end inference including text cleaning, skill extraction, and feature extraction takes 39.23 ms/pair. Cross-Encoder end-to-end inference takes 66.17 ms/pair on CPU.
